messages:
sasha-partnerships: Heads-up — Borealis sent over their compact board for the perf sweep. Can we sync on scope and announcement timing?
min-engr: nice. quick q: are we running our standard Llama-2/Redwood-compat profiles or the compact model stack they requested?
liam-ml: Borealis asked for 4 model configs: 7B fp16, 7B int8, 13B fp16, 13B int8. primary metrics: throughput (tokens/s), tail latency (p95/p99), and perf/W.
borealis-eng: correct. we also want kernel-level knobs turned on/off so we can show delta from our microcode optimizations. will provide firmware image.
sasha-partnerships: ok — deliverables: 1) benchmark CSVs + traces 2) how-to notes for kernel flags 3) a short joint blog draft + push date. timeline?
ana-ops: small correction: it's ana-ops (typo ^^). from infra side we need 48h notice before running noisy thermals. also need kernel-image checksum.
benchbot: automated-run-schedule created: run id 2026-03-borealis-01, window 2026-04-06 02:00-06:00 UTC. use harness v2.3.1.
min-engr: proposed test matrix: sequence lengths {64, 256, 1024}, batch sizes tuned for peak throughput per-device, and prefix-caching enabled/disabled. kernel flags: \n```\n# toggle examples\nKERNEL_PREFETCH=1\nUSE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1\nKV_CACHE_PREFETCH=0\n```\nliam-ml: add a validation eval set (50 prompts) to check quality delta on int8. we must include rouge/bertscore or basic correctness checks so announcement doesn't embarrass us.
borealis-eng: we can sign off on quality checks. firmware image: borealis_v1.2.3.bin sha256: 3a7f...e9c. will upload to S3 with access key.
sasha-partnerships: announcement window — suggested co-publish week of Apr 14. engineering needs to finish runs + draft by Apr 8 to give marketing time. feasible?
min-engr: doable if we get image and run access by Apr 1. schedule looks tight but ok.
nana-ops: infra note: we'll isolate the run to dedicated rack to avoid noisy neighbor variance. will pin to server pool borealis-pool-03.
liam-ml: telemetry we want: power (W) sampled at 1s, GPU_util, temp, tokens/s, p95/p99 latency. csv schema: timestamp, run_id, model, bs, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, p95_ms, p99_ms, power_w, gpu_util_pct, temp_c, kernel_flags.
borealis-eng: that's perfect. we can also provide a hardware spec sheet and thermal mounting notes for the blog.
rachel-pm: PR plan: 1) internal engineering email on Apr 9 2) joint blog + benchmark repo + short demo video Apr 14 3) social snippets Apr 15. legal needs 5 business days to review copy.
sasha-partnerships: action items: @borealis-eng upload firmware + spec by Mar 30; @min-engr confirm harness config by Apr 1; @ana-ops reserve rack and schedule benchbot window; @liam-ml prepare quality evals; @rachel-pm start draft.
min-engr: i'll paste harness config once I finish tuning. quick preview: use concurrent_streams=4, batch_target=auto, perf_sample_interval=1s.
benchbot: run queued: run id 2026-03-borealis-01 (pending infra reservation). notify channel when started.
borealis-eng: one ask — can we include a short “how we tuned kernels” appendix? we'd like a single slide showing before/after per-kernel speedups.
liam-ml: yes, but keep it high level — no proprietary microcode details. we can show percent gains and high-level changes (e.g., "reduced l2 copies, fused attention enabled").
nana-ops: fiscal/ops note: if this goes to marketplace listing, we'll need the agreed perf/W claim framed as "measured on Borealis board with Redwood harness — see repo" and include the test seed.
sasha-partnerships: got it. legal and compliance will check wording.
min-engr: any regression gate? i'd like a quick smoke of latency on our baseline before the long runs. 30 minutes on sample prompts should catch obvious issues.
liam-ml: yup, smoke + quality eval run first. then full matrix.
rachel-pm: marketing asks for 3 highlight tables: perf/W delta across int8 vs fp16, throughput at seq=256, and p99 latency summary. keep tables small for the blog.
borealis-eng: we'll supply raw power curves so you can make charts. happy to co-author visuals.
sasha-partnerships: sweet. i’ll consolidate tasks and ping legal. thanks everyone — will post final schedule tomorrow. :rocket:
min-engr: thanks. will start prepping configs. :thumbsup:
